vocabulary.meaning: 运动；活动；发起运动；参加竞选
笑话；玩笑；开玩笑；说笑话

examples.text: Mary identified（identify的过去式） her bag at first sight by seeing its color.
examples.translation: Mary一眼就根据颜色认出了自己的包。
examples.speechText: Mary identified her bag at first sight by seeing its color.

examples.text: The Swedish app Gimi can guide children to do their homework.
examples.translation: 瑞典的 Gimi 应用程序可以指导孩子们做家庭作业。
examples.speechText: The Swedish app Gimi can guide children to do their homework.

examples.text: His aim was to restore pride in being black and to inspire black Americans to campaign for equal rights.
examples.translation: 他的目标是恢复作为黑人的自豪感，并激励美国黑人为争取平等权利而斗争。
examples.speechText: His aim was to restore pride in being black and to inspire black Americans to campaign for equal rights.

examples.text: They are marked（mark的过去分词形式） by humor and satire and provide his readers with an excellent picture of his time.
examples.translation: 这些作品以幽默和讽刺为特色，为读者生动展现了他所处的时代。
examples.speechText: They are marked by humor and satire and provide his readers with an excellent picture of his time.

examples.text: You don’t have to eat in restaurants all the time, but we don’t recommend a diet of candy and cola, either.
examples.translation: 你不必总去餐馆吃饭，但我们也不建议只靠糖果和可乐度日。
examples.speechText: You don’t have to eat in restaurants all the time, but we don’t recommend a diet of candy and cola, either.

examples.text: Such events have encouraged（encourage的过去分词形式） more and more people to become influencers.
examples.translation: 这类活动鼓励了越来越多的人去成为网络红人。
examples.speechText: Such events have encouraged more and more people to become influencers.

examples.text: For example, they may offer you a temporary contract first as a consultant.
examples.translation: 例如，它们可能先向你提供一份临时合同，让你以顾问身份工作。
examples.speechText: For example, they may offer you a temporary contract first as a consultant.

examples.text: Restrictions on in-person dining during the COVID-19 pandemic led many consumers to shift from in-person dining to takeout orders, increasing plastic waste.
examples.translation: 新冠疫情期间，对堂食的限制使许多消费者从到店用餐转向点外卖，从而增加了塑料垃圾。
examples.speechText: Restrictions on in-person dining during the COVID-19 pandemic led many consumers to shift from in-person dining to takeout orders, increasing plastic waste.

examples.text: Something important has happened（happen的过去分词形式）.
Who does the underlined word "they" in paragraph 5 refer to?
examples.translation: 第五段中下划线的“他们”指的是谁？
examples.speechText: Who does the underlined word "they" in paragraph 5 refer to?

examples.text: He was not involved in the research.
examples.speechText: He was not involved in the research.

examples.translation: 想象一下走进别人公寓的情景。

examples.text: There are so many deserts along the subtropical belt.
examples.speechText: There are so many deserts along the subtropical belt.

examples.text: When we got a call saying she was shortlisted, we thought it was a joke.
examples.translation: 我们接到电话说她入围时，还以为那是个玩笑。
examples.speechText: When we got a call saying she was shortlisted, we thought it was a joke.

examples.text: Mark plays the violin, while his brother prefers（prefer的第三人称单数形式） to play baseball.
examples.translation: Mark拉小提琴，而他的哥哥或弟弟更喜欢打棒球。
examples.speechText: Mark plays the violin, while his brother prefers to play baseball.
